resolved.title: 列表方法
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]List Functions [/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Lists support the following functions:
[b]append[/b](item) adds an item to the end of the list.
[b]insert[/b](index, item) adds an item at the given index in the list.
[b]remove[/b](item) removes an item from the list.
[b]pop[/b](index) removes the item at the given index.
[b]count[/b](item) returns a count of how many times an item occurs in the list.

[s0l0!-header][b]Some examples:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="3122"]x = [2, 4, 6]

x.[b]append[/b](8)
x.[b]remove[/b](4)
x.[b]insert[/b](0, 8)

print(x)

print(x.[b]count[/b](8)) [/code]
[note]Elements that are after the inserted item are shifted to the right.[/note]

[s0l0!-header][h1]List Functions[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

[b]reverse[/b]() reverses items in the list.
[b]sort[/b]() sorts the list. By default, the list is sorted ascending. You can specify [b]reverse=True [/b]as the parameter, to sort descending.
[b]max[/b](list) returns the maximum value.
[b]min[/b](list) returns the minimum value. 

[s0l0!-header][b]Some examples:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="3124"]x = [2, 4, 6, 8]
x.[b]reverse[/b]()
print(x)

x.[b]sort[/b]()
print(x)

print([b]min[/b](x))
print([b]max[/b](x))[/code]
[note]Note, that the [b]reverse[/b]() and [b]sort[/b]() functions change the list they are called on.[/note]

content.text:
- **reverse**(): 将列表中的项目反转。
- **sort**(): 对列表进行排序。默认情况下，列表是升序排序的。你可以指定 **reverse=True** 作为参数，进行降序排序。
- **max**(list): 返回最大值。
- **min**(list): 返回最小值。

**一些例子：**
content.text_html:
reverse() reverses items in the list. sort() sorts the list. By default, the list is sorted ascending. You can specify **reverse=True **as the parameter, to sort descending. max(list) returns the maximum value. min(list) returns the minimum value.

Some examples:

reverse()将列表中的项目反转。 sort()对列表进行排序。默认情况下，列表是升序排序的。你可以指定**reverse=True **作为参数，进行降序排序。 max(list)返回最大值。 min(list)返回最小值。

一些例子：

x.reverse()
print(x)

x.sort()
print(x)

print(min(x))
print(max(x))

resolved.title: 房价分析
resolved.problem_statement_md:
你正在分析房屋价格。给定的代码声明了一个包含附近房价的列表。
你需要计算并输出价格高于平均值的房屋数量。

为了计算房屋的平均价格，你需要用所有价格的总和除以房屋的数量。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]List Functions[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are analyzing house prices. The given code declares a list with house prices in the neighborhood.
You need to calculate and output the number of houses that have a price that is above the average.

To calculate the average price of the houses, you need to divide the sum of all prices by the number of houses.
[note]Use [b]sum(list)[/b] to calculate the sum of all items in the list and [b]len(list)[/b] to get the number of items.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 使用 **sum(list)** 来计算列表中所有项目的总和，使用 **len(list)** 来得到项目的数量。
